title: Armed suspect killed in Saskatchewan
article: Saskatoon police shot and killed a man after he led them on a high-speed chase and shot a police dog late Sunday.
When police were called to a city residence at around 9:30 p.m. local time, the 33-year-old suspect fled in a car and eventually led police along Highway 41 out of the city.
But the chase ended near Wakaw, Sask., when RCMP officers laid a spike belt across the road and flattened two tires on the suspect's vehicle.
Police say the man got out of the car waving a gun, and shot a police dog at the scene, killing the animal. The man was then shot by police.
It was the second fatal shooting by police in the Saskatoon area in the past month. Melvin Wayne Bigsky was killed by police on April 27 outside Saskatoon.
Aboriginal groups have called for an inquiry into Bigsky's death.
